Overview

Track and improve how you use AI. Patterns, not prompts. Data stays on your device.

PreThink AI helps you use ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, and Copilot more deliberately. It tracks usage patterns on your device — which tool, session time, prompt count, and loops — not the text of your conversations. • See AI Load and a 7-day cognitive report in the popup • Optional think-first pause before your first send • Loop nudge when a thread gets repetitive • Export or reset local data anytime All tracking stays in Chrome local storage. We do not operate a cloud account for this data.
